identity.name: project-76-cutting-wide
identity.explanation: This saved core fixture uses the same original artwork but an independently saved model and placement state. Its 487-piece result is distinct from the final public desktop workflow result of 478 pieces; no exact final release execution is claimed for this fixture.

materialArea.domain: Each mapped original face in the saved UV atlas counted once, compared with every output trim triangle. Input face coverage checked independently.

priorNativeValidation.basis: The preserved roundtrip result records passed=true. Its preserved script asserts native manufacturing errors and binding errors are empty, then confirms project and bundle canonical roundtrip equality. This review recomputes counts and areas without rerunning the native solver.

limitations: Area comparison uses the UV atlas and does not establish low distortion or material suitability.
The aggregate numeric tolerance is explicit; area conservation is not claimed to be exact.
The saved core fixture has no final release build identity and must not be represented as the final 478-piece desktop run.
Prior native validation is retained evidence, not a new native execution during this independent review.
